hotspots.title: Trump Administration's Policy Controversies and Legal Challenges
hotspots.blurb: A wave of lawsuits and ethics complaints targets the Trump administration, from the rescinding of a $20 million grant for Boston’s Roxbury neighborhood to accusations of contempt over the Green Card lottery and taxpayer‑funded campaign‑style ads. The stories are framed as abuse of power and illegal use of public resources.
hotspots.affect: The clustering of legal battles and ethics accusations creates a moral panic narrative that the administration is flouting law and ethics.

hotspots.title: Fuel Economy Standards Rollback
hotspots.blurb: The Trump administration announced sharply lower vehicle fuel‑economy standards, cutting projected MPG and revoking Biden’s EV mandate. Coverage emphasizes cost‑saving rhetoric while highlighting environmental backlash and accusations of pandering to auto lobbyists.
hotspots.affect: The story pits economic relief against climate alarm, driving polarized contention and alarmist framing.

hotspots.title: Iran Strait of Hormuz Standoff
hotspots.blurb: President Trump publicly rejected Iran’s proposal to reopen the strategic Strait of Hormuz, framing the offer as a sign of Iran’s weakness. The coverage is steeped in war‑like language and portrays a high‑stakes foreign‑policy showdown.
hotspots.affect: The narrative fuels fear and national‑security alarm, casting the president as a decisive defender against a hostile Iran.

hotspots.title: Midterm Campaign Blitz and Presidents Cup Tour
hotspots.blurb: Trump’s flurry of campaign rallies – from Vandalia to Ohio – and his high‑visibility presence at the Presidents Cup draw both enthusiastic supporters and vocal protesters, generating heated commentary about his influence on upcoming elections.
hotspots.affect: The blend of rally excitement, protest clashes, and election‑impact speculation creates a highly charged political theater.

hotspots.title: Anthropic CEO Dinner and AI Friction
hotspots.blurb: A leaked memo smearing Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei precedes his dinner with President Trump, spotlighting intra‑administrative disputes over AI safety and the president’s courting of tech leaders.
hotspots.affect: The story mixes accusations of political intimidation with the high‑stakes debate over AI governance, intensifying intra‑party and tech‑industry tensions.
